title: Restore backend state with seed data from previous session

requirements.text: Restore the backend canister's per-user state by seeding it with representative default/demo data that reflects the holdings, staking rewards, portfolio history, live snapshots, and user profile values that were present before the Version 47 deployment. Because the canister state was lost, re-populate the stable maps in main.mo with hardcoded seed/init values so the application is no longer empty on load.

quotes: all my data is gone, can you please retrieve it to the values that we have last night ?

acceptanceCriteria: On app load, the dashboard shows non-empty holdings data instead of a blank state.
Staking rewards, portfolio history records, and user profile name are populated with seed values.
The backend actor initialises stable maps with these seed entries so they persist across upgrades.
No runtime errors occur when fetching holdings, staking rewards, or portfolio history.

constraints: Do not change the existing data model types (CryptoHolding, StakingReward, PortfolioHistoryRecord, LivePortfolioSnapshot, UserProfile).
All Motoko logic must remain in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo).
Do not modify any immutable frontend paths.
nonGoals: Connecting to any external database or off-chain storage.
Changing the frontend UI or Version 47 background colour picker feature.
